QuestInfo.name: Brave Like a Hero
QuestInfo.0: Bran doesn't believe you'll ever become a hero. You can't let that slide. Ask him what it'll take to believe you're hero quality.
QuestInfo.1: Even the grown-ups avoid Wolf Forest, east of town, but Bran says a would-be hero could eat that place for breakfast. You aren't scared. You'll show him what a hero looks like!
QuestInfo.2: You strutted out of Wolf Forest, a place even grown-ups are scared of. Yup, you've got the courage of a true hero, if you do say so yourself.

default.0: Still haven't left? Admit it, you're scared.
